descriptions.text: Enchanted Fang Caps of the Expectorating Tizheruk. This is a Fleeting item! Fun fact. There is not a single dentist from your world left in the dungeon. A few made it to the first floor, but every single one of those fuckers is now tits up. There're a few hygienists left, but I wouldn't want to rely on those chuckleheads. What I'm getting at is that you need to install these yourself. Make sure they're facing the right direction. You can always take them off, but this is a fleeting item. That means they disappear once they're off. So don't fuck it up. …

recap.text: Carl and Donut open her Platinum Quest Box and find 5,000 gold, a skill potion and a pair of fang caps. Mordecai says they don't suit her, so Carl snaps them into the sleeping Mongo's mouth, where they resize like Legos. In a muted zone, Carl sends Mongo at a dark elf, and the dinosaur tilts his head like he is eating a taco and caves in its head.

Donut's next platinum quest box holds a pair of fang caps and a skill potion, as the last one did. The first set gave Mongo a damage buff and a chance to poison or paralyze, but the mobs are usually dead before he chomps down. The new caps add 15 percent movement speed and 15 percent strength to the level-29 dinosaur. Donut makes Carl put them in, after he fishes a piece of robot Donut out of Mongo's mouth.

beats.headline: Out of a quest box
beats.text: Donut's Platinum Quest Box holds 5,000 gold, a skill potion and a pair of fang caps. They don't suit her fighting style, Mordecai says: sell them, or give them to Mongo. Most gear can't be swapped with a pet, but these can, and his type can wear up to six pairs. The caps look like loose vampire teeth. Fifty percent more bite damage, a 25 percent chance of level-five poison, 10 percent of paralysis, and they vanish once they come off. Carl, you'll have to put them on him, says Donut. Carl eyes the sleeping dinosaur, who chomps at the air.
beats.gist: Donut's quest box holds fang caps that boost Mongo's bite, and Carl must put them on him.

beats.headline: Snapped in like Legos
beats.text: Getting the two chompers onto Mongo is easier than the description made it sound. The golden fangs resize themselves and snap into his mouth like Legos in about five seconds, while he whimpers like a dog getting his nails clipped. Now little tendrils of electricity burst from his mouth whenever he snaps his teeth. At first it scares him so much he pees himself, which sets Mordecai off. Once he learns the electric bites don't hurt him, he chomps at the air constantly, grunting with excitement at the sparks.
beats.gist: Mongo's golden fang caps snap into his mouth like Legos, and he first pees himself at the sparks.

beats.headline: They bite ghosts
beats.text: The alley on the way to the magistrate's roof is full of Shadow Leaks, smoke-like, ghost-class mobs with a stinging cold attack. Carl's magical gauntlet damages them as easily as if they were flesh, and Mongo's magical teeth caps can hurt them too. The ghosts give off an unusually high amount of experience and are easy to kill. Mongo hits level 13 and gets noticeably larger, rising to the height of Carl's chest.
beats.gist: Mongo's teeth caps hurt the Shadow Leaks, and killing them raises him to level 13 and chest height.

beats.headline: In a muted zone
beats.text: Donut finds the area muted and cannot cast. Mordecai explains: in a muted zone, spells from the menu and scrolls won't cast, but magical items, potions and spells already cast still work. Mongo has those magical teeth caps. Go bite that elf's head off, Carl tells him, but be quick, and Donut says sic 'em. The dinosaur weaves in, turns his head sideways like he is eating a taco, and chomps down. The dark elf's head caves in under the bite, and the purple swirls of magic blink off.
beats.gist: In a muted zone, Donut cannot cast, so Mongo's fang caps cave in the dark elf's head.

beats.headline: A second pair
beats.text: Donut's next platinum quest box holds what the last one did: a pair of fang caps and a skill potion. The first set gave Mongo a damage buff and the chance to poison or paralyze, though neither seems to happen often, because the mobs are usually dead by the time he is chomping down on them. The two new caps add 15 percent movement speed and 15 percent strength to the level-29 dinosaur. Once again Donut makes Carl put them in, and he has to fish a piece of robot Donut out of Mongo's mouth first.
beats.gist: Donut's second platinum box holds fang caps again, adding 15 percent speed and strength to Mongo.
